value.name: finds no codicil in drawer
value.description: Asha searches the drawer and discovers that the codicil is not there.
evidence: There was no codicil in the drawer.

value.name: checks all drawers for codicil
value.description: Asha expands her search and confirms that none of the drawers contain the codicil.
evidence: There was no codicil in any of the drawers.

value.name: suppresses growing dread
value.description: Asha keeps her expression neutral while feeling a cold, growing weight of realization inside her.
evidence: Asha sat back on her heels. She kept her face neutral. She felt, behind her sternum, the small cold weight of the thing she had filed there the day before, and she felt it begin to grow.

value.name: asks about missing folder
value.description: Asha asks Rosa to clarify what kind of folder the missing document was in.
evidence: "Rosa," she said quietly. "You said the folder. Was it manila, like these, or something else?"

value.name: identifies green important papers folder
value.description: Rosa explains that the missing folder was green and used for the deceased woman's important papers.
evidence: "It was green. A green folder, the kind with a pocket on the inside. The señora bought a box of them at the Staples on Broad Street. She used them for what she called the *important* papers. Medical directive. Funeral instructions. The will."

value.name: learns green folders were stored in drawer
value.description: Rosa says there were several green folders in the drawer while the señora was alive.
evidence: "Were there other green folders in this drawer when she was alive?"

value.name: discovers green folders missing
value.description: Asha checks the drawer and realizes that all of the green folders are gone from the drawers she has opened.
evidence: Asha looked at the drawer again. There were no green folders. There were no green folders in any of the drawers she had opened.

value.name: confronts Daniel about folders
value.description: Asha stands and directly asks Daniel where the green folders are.
evidence: She stood up. Her knees clicked. She turned, slowly, and looked at Daniel.

value.name: Daniel withholds answer
value.description: Daniel does not answer immediately, and his posture shifts from authority to self-protection.
evidence: He did not answer at once. His arms were still folded but the fold had changed, had become less a posture of authority and more the posture of a man holding himself together at the ribs.
